## Key Takeaways:


-


**TDX Strategies is onboarding to Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement:** TDX Strategies can access OKX’s global liquidity while supported client assets remain in segregated, regulated custody with BitGo Singapore until settlement.


-


**Access exchange liquidity without holding assets on exchange:** TDX Strategies can execute digital asset strategies while supported client assets remain in insured, regulated custody.


-


**Supporting a more institutional trading model:** Go Network connects regulated custody with exchange liquidity, allowing institutions to separate where assets are held from where they trade.


TDX Strategies is onboarding to BitGo’s expanded Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement integration with OKX, demonstrating institutional demand for market infrastructure that separates asset custody from exchange execution. Founded in 2019, TDX Strategies is a digital asset manager specializing in structured products and bespoke yield strategies for institutional clients, including family offices, funds and digital asset businesses. TDX Strategies serves institutional asset holders, including family offices, funds and digital asset businesses seeking access to actively managed strategies without managing the underlying trading operations themselves.


Through Go Network[Off-Exchange Settlement](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-network-oes/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=okxtdxstrategies) , TDX Strategies can manage execution and access OKX’s global liquidity while supported client assets remain in segregated, regulated custody with BitGo Singapore until settlement. For clients, this means access to managed digital asset strategies without having to trade and maintain assets across exchange accounts themselves. Instead, TDX Strategies manages the strategy and execution, while BitGo provides[regulated custody](https://www.bitgo.com/products/qualified-custody/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=okxtdxstrategies) and settlement infrastructure, maintaining a clear separation between where client assets are held and where they trade.


“As institutional demand for digital asset strategies grows, the ability to access deep liquidity while maintaining independent custody is increasingly important,” said Dick Lo, Founder and CEO of TDX Strategies. “BitGo’s Off-Exchange Settlement with OKX allows us to separate custody from execution while maintaining the market access and execution capabilities our clients require. It’s an important step toward the market structure institutions expect as they increase their participation in digital assets.”


TDX Strategies’ onboarding follows the[international expansion of the OKX and BitGo integration](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/%5BOCT-1-BLOG-SLUG%5D/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=okxtdxstrategies) announced on October 1, 2026, extending Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement to eligible institutions[outside the U.S.](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/okx-to-join-bitgos-go-network/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=okxtdxstrategies)


As institutional participation in digital assets grows, BitGo’s Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement solution provides a model for asset owners and managers to access exchange liquidity without requiring custody and execution to sit with the same counterparty. By connecting regulated custody, exchange liquidity and settlement infrastructure, Go Network gives institutions greater flexibility in how digital assets are held, managed and deployed.


[Connect with the BitGo team](https://calendly.com/d/crmk-p2t-k78?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=okxtdxstrategies) to learn how Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement can support your trading strategy.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is Off-Exchange Settlement?


Off-Exchange Settlement allows eligible institutions to access liquidity on a trading venue while supported assets remain with a separate custodian until settlement.


### How do BitGo clients use Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement with OKX?


BitGo clients can access OKX’s global liquidity to execute its digital asset strategies while supported client assets remain in custody with BitGo Singapore until settlement.


### Why separate digital asset custody from exchange execution?


Separating custody from execution can reduce the need to maintain assets across trading venues, limit direct exchange counterparty exposure, and give institutions greater control over where their assets are held while preserving access to exchange liquidity.


### Who can use Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement with OKX?


The international integration of Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement with OKX is available to eligible institutions outside the U.S. For U.S. institutions, they can access OKX’s global liquidity through Go Network Off-Exchange Settlement with BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association. Institutions should contact BitGo to determine eligibility and supported assets.


### Where are client assets held?


Supported client assets remain in regulated custody with BitGo Singapore until settlement. BitGo Singapore operates under a Major Payment Institution license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore.


### Does BitGo select or manage the strategies?


No. BitGo provides custody and settlement infrastructure. Managers like TDX Strategies independently design and run their strategies.
